subject: Add ACF features (4.2): acf10, season_acf1, differenced ACFs
description:
4.2 feat_acf(): acf1, acf10, diff1_acf1, diff1_acf10, diff2_acf1, diff2_acf10, season_acf1.

SCAN_LOG: 'The repo has no differenced columns at all -- not first, not seasonal.' Verdict NEW: none of these seven exists in the matrix.

Rationale from the book: 'the sum of the first ten squared autocorrelation coefficients is a useful summary of how much autocorrelation there is in a series, regardless of lag.'

season_acf1 is ALSO the diagnostic that settles the lag-12-vs-13 question directly -- it measures autocorrelation at the seasonal lag per brand.

Seasonal differencing is distinct from first differencing: 'the difference between consecutive Januaries, consecutive Februaries.'

SCAN_LOG rates acf10 and season_acf1 'the two highest-value single additions identified so far'. Distinct from 2.B1/2.B2, which cover 4.3 STL features only.

Needs matrix rebuild + retrain.
